content:
[L] high | reading pane bottom: the last conversation message ("Amy Fraughton · Customer… 2026-10-16 14:09") is clipped mid-row by the composer panel overlapping it — content runs beneath another control.
[L] high | composer strip: the reply panel is a floating white card that starts at ~x=870 instead of aligning with the reading pane's left edge (~x=730), leaving an orphaned gray strip of background to its left that belongs to neither panel.
[L] high | right copilot panel bottom: the "Suggested reply" card and its "— Hi Amy," text are cut off at the panel's bottom edge by the composer overlap.
[L] med | conversation list header: the "#"/tag chip button sits oddly next to the search field with a large dead gap before "Apply", and Apply's dark pill height doesn't match the search input height.
[S] high | composer row (To/Cc/Bcc): the field labels To, Cc, Bcc and their inputs are right-shifted into the card with inconsistent left inset versus the Reply/Note tabs above and the Send button below, and label baselines don't align with input text.
[S] med | conversation card: status/assignee/priority/state rows use uneven vertical gaps (State row is cramped, Snooze row floats with excess space beneath the tag row).
[S] med | list rows: row #501 is a highlighted card with left accent bar while row #502 is bare with no card treatment — inconsistent row styling and different internal padding.
[S] med | top header: "Closed" link, Copilot pill, and the circle icon are spaced unevenly across the header with a large dead zone between "Closed" and Copilot.
[H] med | conversation card: the "sentiment: positive" chip floats detached below the card at mixed weight, unpaired with any content.
[H] med | copilot panel: "local: no configuration needed" debug-style literal string sits at header level with no label/value pairing.
[C] high | middle-left region: a large empty dead zone (~y=430–940) under list row #502 while the reading pane is crushed and clipped at the bottom.
[C] med | three-column composition: the copilot panel is separated only by whitespace with no visible boundary, so it visually merges into the reading pane and collides with the composer region.
[C] med | copilot "Signals" card: the card's right edge and the summary card's right edge are misaligned, and the summary card overflows toward the panel edge.
[C] low | toolbar: the clock/circle icon at top-right is unexplained and reads as debug chrome.
VERDICT: unprofessional — overlapping panels, clipped content, and floating misaligned composer make this read as a debug tool, not a product.
